prior06.status: PARTIAL: native-layout candidates do not yet certify globally maximal actual ink

scope: Only this fixed served08, actual installed MicrosoftJhengHeiUIRegular 16px face and current slider ranges. CSS/font/source changes invalidate proof. Does not certify unrelated text, games, replay or whole project.
derivation: All three phases reduce to finite numeric tokens from 27 time values, 161 x values and 23 size values. Font whole-face glyph bounds contain every possible glyph including GSUB ligatures, so no Cartesian message enumeration or guessed layout classes are required. Native normal wrapping/anywhere contains horizontal glyph origins in the content line, which is at least 220px wide, exceeding every whole-face advance (20.8515625px); text is one plain text node. Font strut is constant with complete cmap and single actual platform face. Auto block height grows by full lineHeight for every line, so first/last-line bounds apply for any line count. Stage is a later sibling normal-flow block, and its absolute images are clipped to its relative stage. Fixed original panel safe insets are less than12px after worst offsetHeight rounding; proof uses narrower12px insets.
global_gap: Whole-font source outline bounds do not by themselves prove TrueType hinted/raster ink differs by at most the assumed1px. Actual six samples and conditional outline/flow arithmetic pass; a native rendered reachable-glyph bound is still required for an unconditional global ink gate.
